q: Our courier offers a carbon neutral shipping option. Does it cut our emissions?
title: Courier carbon neutral shipping option
short: Not in your inventory. The courier usually pays for carbon credits to match the delivery's estimated emissions. Your shipping emissions stay in Scope 3 at their gross value; the credits can be reported separately. Ask the courier which credits, how many and where they are retired.
audience: Exporters and online sellers using courier services

ul: Shipping emissions: Scope 3, category 4 or 9 depending on who pays.
Credits bought on your behalf: a separate line, never subtracted.
Wording: say the courier offset the delivery, not that you are carbon neutral.
Emissions estimate per shipment and the method.
Credit registry, project and serial numbers.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure behind a claim traceable to the invoices and bills it came from, so a reader can check the number rather than take the wording on trust.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
